description: OSBORN is an independent technology initiative built around Humanity and Infinity. Humanity focuses on real-world challenges on Earth, while Infinity explores space, advanced technology, and the unknown. For NASA Space Apps Challenge, OSBORN aims to transform NASA data and engineering concepts into practical, intuitive solutions for Earth and space.
summary: Lunar Landing Site Navigator helps compare 6 Moon's South Pole landing sites by Sun, water ice, and communication, test What-If launch delay, and check Dust Hazard, Water Ice Finder, and Night Survival, using NASA data.
details:
Lunar Landing Site Navigator

Lunar Landing Site Navigator compares 6 Moon's South Pole landing sites in 30 seconds. Pick a site, test What-If launch delay, balance Power vs Communication, and check Dust, Water Ice, and Night Survival. BEST SITE: Shackleton Rim - Overall 90.
